## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [道通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%80%9A) Dàotōng is a compact treatise on the *[Fǎ jiè guānmén 法界觀門](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0101)* tradition, framed as *pī yún* 披雲 ("parting the clouds" — i.e. clarifying the obscured doctrinal substance). The text supplements Dàotōng's other works (*[Tūn hǎi jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0123)*, *[Pán jié](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0132)*) with a focused treatment of the foundational Huáyán contemplative-doctrinal apparatus.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1100 – 1280) reflects the Southern-Sòng period of [道通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%80%9A) Dàotōng's activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1014) collection.
